findings.quote: Forgetting to include half the rope's mass below the mid-point gives 98 N there instead of 112.5 N.
findings.note: The stated cause (using only the 7 kg block below the mid-point) gives 7 × (9.8 + 2.7) = 87.5 N, not 98 N. No error described here produces 98 N.
findings.fix: Forgetting to include half the rope's mass below the mid-point gives 7 × 12.5 = 87.5 N there instead of 112.5 N.
